not_covered: JavaScript strings under scrypath_ops/assets/js are neither scanned nor rendered by any row.
HTML attribute text that is not rendered text (aria-label, title, placeholder) is not guarded; a row can catch it only by accident.
Playwright locators and assertion names are read only by the Control room casing row, never by the status wording rows.
Screen states with no named fixture surface are not rendered; a row's static scan still reads their source.

rules.rule: Searchable is the label for one record's observed state, never a setting value: say Used for search or Not used for search.
The Searchable fields settings row reads Used for search, Not used for search and Not used for search yet.
The label is Control room in sentence case, never in title case.
